Experience and discover electronic music in a better way: DI.FM is a 100% human-curated electronic music platform, designed to satisfy all of your listening cravings. 
 
With the abundance of the world’s music just a few taps away, finding the right tunes to play can feel like a challenge.
 
Join DI.FM today and start hearing dedicated electronic music curators, DJ's, artists, audiophiles, producers, stream live and drop mixes that inspire, transport, energize and relax. Discover a community that's the first to hear brand new exclusive sets, classic favorites and all the innovative music in between. 
 
Features: 

- Over 90 different stations of electronic music streaming 24/7 
- Stream 65 new playlists curated to bring you the best of new, elusive, and budding styles within the electronic music genre.
- CarPlay support: listen to your favorite music all in a way that allows you to stay focused on the road. Just connect your iPhone and go.
- Stream exclusive mix shows from some of the biggest names in Electronic Music. Over 15 years of music at your fingertips! 
- Explore the calendar for DJ Shows and live broadcasts and set reminders to tune in and listen 
- Use the style filters to find your favorite music styles and save your favorites for easy access 
- Share tracks and channels you've discovered with friends 
- Stream music from the open app or in the background 

 
Check out some of our top channels: 
 
Trance
Chillout
Progressive
Vocal Trance
Lounge
Deep House
Techno
Ambient
Space Dreams
Synthwave
Chill & Tropical House
…and many more

DI.FM offers exclusive mix shows from some of the biggest names in Electronic Music:
Martin Garrix - The Martin Garrix Show
Armin van Buuren - A State Of Trance
Hardwell - Hardwell On Air
Spinnin' Records - Spinnin' Sessions
Paul van Dyk - VONYC Sessions
Don Diablo - Hexagon Radio
Sander van Doorn - Identity
Paul Oakenfold - Planet Perfecto
Claptone - Clapcast
Ferry Corsten - Corsten's Countdown
Markus Schulz - Global DJ Broadcast
…and many more

 
DI.FM Premium: 
 
- Enjoy your favorite beats 100% ad-free 
- Better sound quality: Choose between 320k MP3 and 128k AAC options 
- Stream DI.FM on Sonos, Roku, Pioneer, Squeezebox, Denon, Phillips, or any that support vTuner or TuneIn 
 -Premium access to all our other music platforms: JAZZRADIO.com, ClassicalRadio.com, RadioTunes, and ROCKRADIO.com. Enjoy access to 200+ additional human-curated of high-quality music! 
 
 
HOW IT WORKS:

Getting started is simple. Download the DI.FM app now and start listening for free. Monthly and annual premium plans are available.

If you purchase an annual plan and are eligible for a 30-day free trial, you can cancel at any time during your free trial via the iTunes store settings and then you will not be charged. Also, plans automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew in your iTunes account 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period.

If you do not select a plan with a trial, payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Your plan will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew in your iTunes account 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period.


You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

results.description:
Radio FM – Live Radio, FM Stations & Podcasts

Listen to your favourite radio stations, discover new music and stay up to date with news, sports and podcasts—all in one simple app. Explore more than 55,000 stations and 4.2M podcasts from Germany and around the world, with an easy to use radio player designed for everyday listening. 

Trusted by more than 100 million listeners worldwide, Radio FM makes it easy to find local radio stations, international broadcasts and your favorite programs wherever you are.

LIVE RADIO & MUSIC

Enjoy live radio stations for every mood and moment. Listen to pop, rock, country, jazz, classical, hip-hop, R&B, electronic, dance, reggae, gospel, oldies, retro, instrumental music and more.

Discover music radio from the United States and around the world, find new stations and listen to your favorite music anytime.

Explore more than 55,000 live radio stations from thousands of cities and countries.

Search by station, country, location, genre or language to quickly find the radio you want to hear.

LOCAL RADIO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

Looking for a local radio station? Select a location on the map and discover stations available in that area. Find your hometown station or explore radio from cities and countries around the world.

NEWS & TALK RADIO

Stay informed with live news radio, breaking news, talk radio, interviews and current affairs programs. Listen to news and discussion programs from local and international stations while commuting, working or relaxing.
SPORTS RADIO


Follow your favorite sports with live sports radio, sports news, football radio, baseball, basketball, hockey, tennis and more.
Listen to sports commentary, match updates, expert analysis, interviews and sports talk from radio stations around the world.

Over 4.2M PODCASTS

Explore more than 4M podcasts covering news, business, technology, sports, comedy, education, entertainment, history, culture, motivation and personal development.
Discover new shows and listen to podcasts that match your interests, alongside your favorite radio stations.

POWERFUL RADIO PLAYER

Radio FM is designed to make listening simple:

• Play live radio with one tap
• Search for radio stations and podcasts
• Save stations to Favorites
• Quickly access recently played stations
• Browse stations by country, genre and language
• Find stations with the radio tuner
• Equalizer to customize your listening experience
• Car Mode for safer, easier listening while driving
• Caste Screen & Widget Feature
• Continue listening with background playback
• View currently playing information
• Control playback from your device
• Share what you are listening to

SLEEP TIMER & ALARM

Fall asleep while listening to your favorite music radio, talk radio or podcast with the Sleep Timer. Set the timer and playback automatically stops at the time you choose.
Use the Alarm Clock to wake up with your favorite radio station and start your morning with music, news or talk radio.

LISTEN WHILE YOU DRIVE

Enjoy radio and podcasts while driving with supported in-car features, including Apple CarPlay. Quickly access your favorite stations and keep listening while on the road.
WHY CHOOSE RADIO FM?

 Live FM and AM radio
 Internet and online radio
 Local radio station discovery
 Music, news, sports and talk radio
 Radio tuner and powerful search
 Favorites and recently played stations
 Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock
 Background playback
 Apple CarPlay support
 Simple and convenient radio player

Can't find a station you want? Use Suggest a Station to request a radio station you'd like to see added to the catalog.
An internet or Wi-Fi connection is required for live radio and podcast streaming.

For any suggestions or queries in the app you can write to us on support@appradiofm.com 

Keep listening with Radio FM.

A collage soundscape sequencer.

MOUND is a unique touch instrument (standalone and AUv3 instrument and MIDI included) that uses collage and paint to generate music.
You get four layers of stamps to populate chord progressions automatically using euclidean sequencing, and up to 6 paintbrush effects to use your gestures for uninhibited sonic combinations.

FEATURES

- Four mix channels — chord channel, and three other voices to layer.
- 100+ soundfont instruments
- Paint to drive effects — use X/Y and hold to control effects
- Evolve — mutate your canvas and hear new possibilities
- Choose key and scale
- Choose BPM and sequence length
- FREE Cassette Effect and Granular Delay

Free to play. Unlock the full SoundFont library, advanced EVOLVE
theory settings, and the rest of the spray effects. 

Built by fourtrack.fm.

Live365 is a diverse online radio network featuring thousands of human powered radio stations created by people from around the world. With the Live365 app, anyone can easily discover and listen to unique Live365 radio stations anywhere they go.

Live365 allows listeners to easily find the perfect station for any musical taste enabling the discovery of music and talk content you won’t find or hear anywhere else. The app features hundreds of music genres covering everything imaginable ranging from Rock, Classical, Jazz, Electronic, Country, Gospel, Pop, Hip-Hop/R&B, International, Reggae, Broadway, Meditation, Oldies, Talk, and more. Live365’s online radio stations are created by music and talk enthusiasts from hobbyists to professional broadcasters.

Live365 is different from other Internet Radio services because Live365 provides each broadcaster with the platform and tools they need to create their own online radio station and reach their audience. For the listener, this means more unique, diverse, and quality music and talk content over other radio services like AM/FM, Satellite, and other Online Radio networks with robotic playlists. Download the Live365 app today and start experiencing the Radio Revolution!
